name: Image-Based Object Detection
description: Object detection computer-vision framework predicting 2D bounding boxes, confidence probabilities, and multi-class labels in digital imagery.
limitations: Severe motion blur or small distant objects (<16x16 pixels) present lower detection recall.
responsible_use_notes: Ensure surveillance privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, local biometrics acts) are strictly adhered to in real-world deployments.
